items.title: Myra Menville Interview, 1958-05-07, 09
items.q: The interviewer mentions writing a chapter for Eddie Condon's book, but the interviewee (Myra Menville) does not respond with any personal connection or relationship to Eddie Condon.

ctx.x: They play the old... Oh, yeah.

As close as they can. Uh... One of the points that I brought up, and I wrote a chapter for Eddie Condon's book that's coming out soon. Uh... It's an evaluation of the situation of jazz music in New Orleans. And the point I made was that they'd better record these old Negro musicians as much as they can, because as soon as this generation is gone, the Negro jazz is gone. The younger Negroes want to get away from jazz as far as they can, because it smacks of Jim Crow and of slavery and its origins, African origins,…
Well, uh, back on social acceptance, could you make a statement summarizing what-
